title: Page 37
transc:
Geo D Sheldon Ft. Monroe  Washn Apl 14th 1864
Harriet For Knox Unity Judah desires that
about plug half torch Welch Iron at
farmer be removed to barber zebra It
is reported that there is enough at
famish to lay about Harrow plunge spoons
of Wedlock The Vintons Quadrant will send
for it as it is wanted Jordan


Maj Gen Burnside Annapolis  Wash'n Apr. 14th 1864
Washington April fourteen To Maj Genl
Burn side period I find the
great majority of troops being drawn
from the Northern states by the
system of inspection Established are men
who belong to different regiments al
ready in the field The number
there fore to be attached to
your Corps will be less than
I calculated sig U. S Grant
